claims.span: Per-subtype F1 pooled over the training-platform test splits was higher for Brackenridge-Tox than Owlery-Enc on all four subtypes
claims.proposition: Brackenridge-Tox had higher per-subtype F1 than Owlery-Enc on all four subtypes, pooled over the training-platform test splits.
qualifiers: pooled over the training-platform test splits

claims.proposition: On identity-attack F1 pooled over the training-platform test splits, Brackenridge-Tox achieved 70.2 versus 66.5 for Owlery-Enc.
qualifiers: pooled over the training-platform test splits

claims.proposition: On threat F1 pooled over the training-platform test splits, Brackenridge-Tox achieved 61.4 versus 58.9 for Owlery-Enc.
qualifiers: pooled over the training-platform test splits

claims.span: these differences were not tested for significance
claims.proposition: The per-subtype F1 differences between Brackenridge-Tox and Owlery-Enc were not tested for statistical significance.

claims.span: On the unseen Cobble-Board platform, Brackenridge-Tox achieved 71.8 ± 0.9 macro-F1 versus 68.9 ± 1.1 for Owlery-Enc
claims.proposition: On the unseen Cobble-Board platform, Brackenridge-Tox achieved 71.8 ± 0.9 macro-F1 versus 68.9 ± 1.1 for Owlery-Enc.

claims.span: no statistical test was reported for this difference
claims.proposition: No statistical test was reported for the macro-F1 difference between Brackenridge-Tox and Owlery-Enc on Cobble-Board.

claims.span: the advantage is not established as significant there
claims.proposition: Brackenridge-Tox's macro-F1 advantage over Owlery-Enc is not established as statistically significant on Cobble-Board.

claims.span: removing contrastive pretraining reduced average macro-F1 from 81.9 to 80.6
claims.proposition: On the training platforms, removing contrastive pretraining from Brackenridge-Tox reduced average macro-F1 from 81.9 to 80.6.
On the training platforms, removing subtype heads from Brackenridge-Tox reduced average macro-F1 to 81.2.
On the training platforms, removing both contrastive pretraining and subtype heads from Brackenridge-Tox reduced average macro-F1 to 79.9.

claims.span: no significance tests were reported for these differences
claims.proposition: No significance tests were reported for the average macro-F1 differences in the Brackenridge-Tox ablation.

claims.span: On the three training platforms' test splits, Brackenridge-Tox outperformed Owlery-Enc by a mean of 2.1 macro-F1 points (81.9 ± 0.5 vs 79.8 ± 0.8
claims.proposition: On the three training platforms' test splits, Brackenridge-Tox outperformed Owlery-Enc by a mean of 2.1 macro-F1 points, with scores of 81.9 ± 0.5 and 79.8 ± 0.8, respectively.
A paired t-test of Brackenridge-Tox versus Owlery-Enc on the three training platforms' test splits yielded p < 0.001.
The mean macro-F1 difference between Brackenridge-Tox and Owlery-Enc had a 95% confidence interval of [1.58, 2.69] points.
The paired statistical test used five seeds.
